title: test(vi-b): land the pins the mutation-pins lanes measured
body:
Repair of the #2140 blocked verdict (review comment 6116097329, evidence
/private/tmp/r9-review-2140): keep both speed cuts, fix the two metered-contract
breaks CI's `fast (3.14)` stress run named. No stress check, budget or claim
file is rewritten — both reds are repaired in production code.

**Contract reading, one sentence:** the #1229 simulate-work meter pins the cost
model's honesty — it counts the simulate work a solve actually does — so a memo
hit that does no work is correctly invisible to it, and the honest repair is to
stop the memo from masking the work, not to re-record the meter; keying the memo
at the fused fun (above the probe's gradient seam) does exactly that, so the
meter's own checks pass unmodified.

The memo (cut 2) now wraps `_fused_value_and_gradient`'s fun and keys on `x`
(the row matrix is a pure function of `x` under the call's fixed bounds and
`fd_eps`, so the served bits are unchanged), bounded to the 512 most recent
points. The row-matrix key it replaces held ~37-75 KiB per entry for the whole
multi-start call; an `x` key is ~0.8 KiB. Cut 1 (row_sums) is untouched.

## Head

`e7666cdf9d2aaf0de1154e8e4668df1875c03197` merges main `664a4c0` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution. The reviewed code is unchanged.

`5c611764026aedcb69ae9b1a0b866ca0e91939b5` is the orchestrator's recarry of main into the previous head (GitHub reported a mutation-ledger pin-row conflict it cannot resolve without a hand union). It is not a clean merge of the live head and main (parent 1 and parent 2 do not merge cleanly; a resolution goes through prepr), so prepr checked this head.

It is not a clean merge of the live head and main (parent 1 and parent 2 do not merge cleanly; a resolution goes through prepr), so prepr checked this head.

It is not a clean merge of the live head and main (parent 1 and parent 2 do not merge cleanly; a resolution goes through prepr), so prepr checked this head.

`b78e71902e87443204c59f3ed1a4dd33c2449961` adds the delivery row `dev/programme/delivery/2149.md` alone (the merge train's row check): `git diff bf812a9e1e418bb4d3cc4e26c9e92dedb9e82140...b78e71902e87443204c59f3ed1a4dd33c2449961 --name-only` names that one file; the reviewed code is unchanged.

bf812a9e1 (branch fix/replay-speed-memo-pins; parents 0ea389dfc -> 9516c13bd
-> bf812a9e1). 9516c13bd adds the two killing checks this body previously
owed (tests/features.py, the D9-03 memo section; `git diff 0ea389dfc --stat`
touches `tests/features.py` only, 70 insertions); bf812a9e1 lands the two
pins those checks measured (`tests/mutation_ledger/` only). The production
diff over the merge base is unchanged since 0ea389dfc: `git diff 0ea389dfc --
custom_components` is empty. The scoped gate, replay oracle and stress runs
below were measured at the earlier heads as marked; the figures re-taken at
this head are the features run, the pin drive and the mutation table.

## Mutation proof

All mutants restored byte-exact (`git checkout --`) after each run; the tree at
push is the head.

- **The fix deleted** (PR-head `optimizer.py` restored verbatim, i.e. the
  unbounded rows-keyed batch memo): the memory probe the stress memory pass
  runs — `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/stress.py --memory-probe
  '{"season": "shoulder", "building": "heavy_old", "dhw": true}'` — prints
  `traced_mb: 24.6` against 3.46 recorded (x1.5 threshold 5.19): red on "the
  probed scenarios' memory peaks stay within their recorded budgets"; and the
  #1229 probe arm driver prints `gradient-twice: 48 evals, 159168 sim; ratio
  1.0000 (check needs >= 1.5)`: red on "the simulate-work meter sees a real
  solve, and doubles on the cost-only arm the evaluation count is blind to
  (#1229)" and on "the cost-only arm reaches the rule the sweep applies, and an
  unchanged solve does not (#1229)". Both CI red families return with the fix
  gone.
- **Memo hit path deleted** (`if hit is not None: ... return hit` removed): the
  served-count driver (`/private/tmp/r9-fix-vib2/hits_driver.py`, wraps
  `_fused_value_and_gradient` and `_memoized_value_and_gradient` around
  `build_case` on heavy_old/shoulder) prints `served=0` against `served=129` on
  the fix tree — the speedup's liveness, which no gate check pins by design
  (cost is the stress budgets' job).
- **h9 hit counting deleted** (the harness hook's `if key in memo_dict` block
  removed): `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub ... python3
  dev/audit/rounds/round4/D9/h9_batch_cost_loop.py` prints
  `cost_terms_batch_calls_per_gradient=0.954407`,
  `batch_rows_per_gradient=92.5775`,
  `null_control_batched_calls_per_gradient_delta=-0.00399407` — the three exact
  pins `tests/harness_headers.py` compares (1 / 97 / 0) go red by name.
- **LRU eviction deleted** (the two cap lines removed): the memory probe on the
  four blown scenarios is unchanged (3.41 MiB) — the cap does not engage there
  (347-585 distinct points per solve); it is priced, not check-pinned, in
  Unpinned sites below.
- Stress.py per-mutant runs are left to CI's required mutation check per the
  fixer contract; every mutant above is driven by the same command the failed
  check runs.

## Null control

- The unmodified fix head, same drivers: memory probe heavy_old/shoulder
  `traced_mb: 3.41` (recorded 3.46); #1229 probe arm `ratio 1.9940`; h9 pins
  exactly `1`, `97`, `0`.
- The memo still fires: the replay's channel_boost arm, counted with the same
  wrapper style the review used — 11,309 memo hits at this head against 11,311
  at the blocked head: the LRU cap costs 2 of 11,311 repeats (99.98%).
- Byte-identity oracle: the full replay stdout at this head md5s
  `e55bc72a233d065e49375bd344a016a9` and `cmp`s identical against the review's
  recorded head output `/private/tmp/r9-review-2140/replay-head.out` (base and
  head captures share the md5); 46/46 BOOST DRIFT CHECKS PASSED.

## Figures

- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/stress.py --memory-probe <spec>` (the
  memory pass's own subprocess command), fix head vs recorded budget:
  heavy_old/shoulder 3.41 / 3.46; winter/cycle 3.41 / 3.46; winter/pv+cycle
  3.42 / 3.46; typical_slab/shoulder 1.98 / 1.82 (threshold = record x1.5).
  At the blocked head: 24.6 local on the first (CI: 27.0-41.1 across the four).
- Scoped gate `GATE_SCOPE=auto GOLDEN_MODE=drift GOLDEN_REF=<merge-base>
  ./tests/run.sh` at bdc617f8d (`/private/tmp/r9-fix-vib2/gate.log`): ALL 106
  STRESS CHECKS PASSED — including both #1229 checks by name and the memory
  budget check — ALL 46 BOOST DRIFT CHECKS PASSED, and every other scoped
  script green except the two paid below.
- `python3 tests/features.py` at the head: ALL 4039 FEATURE CHECKS PASSED.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/features.py` at 9516c13bd (= bf812a9e1's
  tree for this script): rc=0, ALL 4042 FEATURE CHECKS PASSED, 4:53 wall
  (null control for the two kills; the 4039 figure earlier in this section
  was measured at 0ea389dfc before the checks landed).
- Hand-applied mutants, each restored byte-exact after its run (`git diff`
  clean against 9516c13bd): :568 GUARD_OFF (`if memo is None:` ->
  `if False:`) rc=1 "2 of 4042 FEATURE CHECKS FAILED" in 258 s, both failing
  checks the new vi-b section's ("with no memo the wrapper returns the plain
  fused fun, working" with `err=AttributeError("'NoneType' object has no
  attribute 'get'")`; "the memo's served pair is the plain fun's pair, to
  the bit"); :583 RETURN_DEL (`return fun` -> `pass`) rc=1 at 315 s with
  `TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not callable` at `_vib_memo_arms` —
  no FAIL summary line, the early crash is the verdict.
- `python3 tests/mutation_table.py --scope changed --base origin/main
  --max 10 --jobs 3` at bf812a9e1 (CI's own invocation): "4597 unpinned
  site(s) of 6042 candidate sites, 4602 at the ratchet base", the null
  control survived every driver it ran under, "0 survivor(s) of 3 evaluated
  = 0.0%, cap 20.0%", MUTATION TABLE PASSED (1417 s).
- `python3 tests/structure.py` at bf812a9e1: STRUCTURE RATCHET PASSED;
  `python3 -I tools/audit/seat/tmp_paths.py --check`: 0 refused, 0 stale.
- `python3 tests/structure.py` at the head: STRUCTURE RATCHET PASSED.
- h9 harness FINAL RESULT at the head: `1`, `97`, `0` (exact pins).
- Reuse-structure measurement behind the cap (instrumented memo wrapper over
  `build_case`): heavy_old/shoulder 476 evaluations, 129 repeats (27%),
  reuse-distance p50/p90/p99 = 2/41/111; winter/pv+cycle 596 calls, 585
  distinct points, key bytes 74,496/entry at the blocked head — the 41 MiB.

## Red checks

- `fast (3.14)` (red at 969330de7, an ancestry commit this branch merges —
  the head the #2140 review blocked on): the stress run's two #1229
  simulate-work meter breaks and the four blown per-scenario traced-memory
  peaks, both the memo's. Repaired in production by 821b547bb (the x-keyed
  fused-fun memo, LRU-capped): the same run's drivers measured green at
  every head since (scoped-gate figures below name both #1229 checks PASSED
  and the memory probe back inside its budgets). The two defect entries
  immediately below are this red's causes and countermeasures.
- `mutation` (red at c1a56b4e2: "4604 unpinned site(s) against 4602 at the
  ratchet base, 7 of them added by this diff"): the check refuses ANY
  diff-added unpinned site, not only count growth (`ratchet_refusal ... or
  added`), so the bot's 8 pins at that head left it red. Five of the seven
  added sites are now disposed by measured pins: :579 CMP_BOUND killed by
  `tests/entities.py` and :576 RETURN_DEL killed by `tests/harness_headers.py`
  (both from the lanes' artifacts, re-verified here by hand — entities rc=1
  "1 of 2251 failed", harness_headers rc=1 "3 of 109 failed", clean at
  rc=0 both), :522 CONST killed by `tests/stress.py`, :675 GUARD_OFF and :816
  GUARD_OFF killed by `tests/features.py` (re-measured at a 3000s driver
  timeout: rc=0 failed=0 to rc=1 failed=1 and failed=3; the lanes
  skip-timed-out both at 1200s). Count falls 4604 to 4599, below the 4602
  base. The last two added sites are now disposed by the killing checks
  9516c13bd lands (the memo-arms section in `tests/features.py`), not by a
  survivor triage: :568 GUARD_OFF — a measured survivor under every closure
  driver, because no production caller reaches the memo-None arm — is killed
  by a check that calls the wrapper with `memo=None` directly, and :583
  RETURN_DEL — which times the caught form out even at 3000s because it
  disables the batched jac for every later solve in the script — is killed
  by a check that calls the wrapper's return immediately and uncaught, so
  the mutant crashes the script 315 s in, inside the driver's 1200 s floor,
  and the driver reads rc=1 with a traceback instead of a timeout. Both
  pinned by `mutation_table.py --pin-killed` at 9516c13bd (killed by
  `tests/features.py`, failed=3 and failed=1); `mutation_table.py --scope
  changed --base origin/main --max 10 --jobs 3` at bf812a9e1 prints 4597
  unpinned sites against the 4602 base, 0 survivors of 3 evaluated, MUTATION
  TABLE PASSED — the red is answered.
- The process gap that made this red unrepairable by CI alone:
  `mutation-ledger-push` is main-only by design (`github.ref ==
  'refs/heads/main'` in tests.yml), and `mutation-autofix`'s pins commit
  carries old-text digests measured at an earlier head — at c1a56b4e2 two of
  the bot's eight rows named anchors no inventory site holds (e.g.
  `_memoized_value_and_gradient.fun GUARD_OFF 3d5ec960`, `old: "if hit is not
  None:"`, a line the memo rewrite deleted), so they dispose nothing. The
  measured pins therefore have to be landed on the branch by a seat, as this
  commit does. Friction line below.
- "the simulate-work meter sees a real solve, and doubles on the cost-only arm
  the evaluation count is blind to (#1229)" and "the cost-only arm reaches the
  rule the sweep applies, and an unchanged solve does not (#1229)": cause — the
  memo wrapped the batch objective *below* the probe's `_batch_fd_gradient`
  seam, so the manufactured duplicate was served from cache and did zero
  simulate work; the meter was never rewritten and stays the detector. Cheaper
  detector that would have caught it pre-CI: the review's own counting-wrapper
  liveness probe already printed it (11,311 hits with a duplicated-gradient
  arm showing no extra work); its standing cost is one instrumented replay arm
  (~10 min) — it was run by the reviewer, not the fixer, and the structural
  fix removes the masking class itself (any sub-fun duplicate now re-simulates
  and reddens the meter again).
- "the probed scenarios' memory peaks stay within their recorded budgets":
  cause — the memo retained each ~37-75 KiB FD row-matrix key plus output for
  the whole `_multi_start_minimize` call. Cheaper detector: the memory probe
  command above, ~15 s per scenario on the four budget leaders, runnable
  pre-push without the sweep; it is the same subprocess the check drives, so
  nothing new would need building.

## Unpinned sites

- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:522 CONST (`_EVAL_MEMO_MAX_ENTRIES = 512`), the LRU bound's value: **pinned** — `tests/stress.py` (rc=0 failed=0 to rc=1 failed=1, recorded by the local `--pin-killed` drive against the base).
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:565 GUARD_OFF (the batch_objective None arm): pinned by CI's `mutation-autofix` at c1a56b4e2.
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:568 GUARD_OFF (the memo None arm): **pinned** — `tests/features.py` (the vi-b memo-arms check drives the wrapper with `memo=None` directly; no production caller reaches the arm, which is why every closure driver measured it LIVES). `mutation_table.py --pin-killed` at 9516c13bd: rc=0 failed=0 to rc=1 failed=3; hand-applied mutant the same: rc=1, "2 of 4042 FEATURE CHECKS FAILED" in 258 s.
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:574 GUARD_OFF: pinned by CI's `mutation-autofix` at c1a56b4e2.
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:576 RETURN_DEL (memo hit path): **pinned** — `tests/harness_headers.py` (lane artifact, hand-verified: rc=1 failed=3 on the mutant, "RESULT ... matches header" pins).
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:579 CMP_BOUND (the eviction bound): **pinned** — `tests/entities.py` (lane artifact, hand-verified: rc=1 failed=1); its :579 GUARD_OFF and :581 RETURN_DEL twins: pinned by CI's `mutation-autofix` at c1a56b4e2.
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:583 RETURN_DEL (memo return): **pinned** — `tests/features.py` (the same check calls the wrapper's return IMMEDIATELY and uncaught, so a None return crashes early in the script, 315 s to the traceback, where the driver reads rc=1 instead of the pathological-slow timeout the caught form would pay). `mutation_table.py --pin-killed` at 9516c13bd: rc=0 failed=0 to rc=1 failed=1.
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:675 BOOLOP and :816 BOOLOP (`memo_fun is not None and ...`): pinned by CI's `mutation-autofix` at c1a56b4e2; :675 GUARD_OFF and :816 GUARD_OFF: **pinned** — `tests/features.py` (re-measured at 3000s: rc=1 failed=1 "a batched solve never evaluates the scalar objective inside L-BFGS-B" and rc=1 failed=3 "the pinned solve runs on the batched jac").
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:2768 RETURN_DEL and custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:2783 CLAMP_DROP: cut 1's row_sums arms, inherited unchanged from the blocked head this branch merges; pinned there by the bitwise-equal bench and the golden/env-drift lanes, and by CI's mutation check here.

## Forward-carry

none

## Friction

- ci-autofix.md: cost: on a pull request the measured pins exist only as workflow artifacts — `mutation-ledger-push` is main-only by design — so a seat must land them by hand and `mutation` stays red until the seat's commit lands; and the pins lanes measure with the drivers' default 1200s timeout, which `tests/features.py` exceeds on the memo mutants (:675, :816 killed at 3000s), so a red `mutation` can persist beside green `mutation-pins` lanes whose residue reads skip-timed-out, not survivor — the PIN KILLED summary's split is the part to read.
